title: Shared board step 1: log in with GitHub and show each person only the repositories GitHub lets them read
notes: Design: board spec, section Shared mode. GitHub App OAuth web flow with the standard library, signed session cookie, server clones read through the App installation, per-user repository access cached briefly. Filter in workspace_cards before the payload.
done_when: A logged-in GitHub user sees only cards of workspace repositories they can read on GitHub, in the page and the JSON; no login or a failed check gets nothing; a test with a stubbed GitHub proves another user's private task text is absent from the payload
